research_exemption: Archiving, research, statistics without personal results may reuse public, lawfully collected or pseudonymised data; otherwise special law, consent or DPA authorisation (s. 7 DSG)
genetic_data: GDPR art. 9 special category; for research under s. 7 requires important public interest and processing by persons bound by secrecy; Gene Technology Act also applies
notes: DSG (ex-DSG 2000) as amended; 2024 novelle added Parliamentary Data Protection Committee
